explanation: Lemma 2.2’s own proof asserts that the cited Samuels and Jogdeo--Samuels results give exactly the bound \(\Pr[X_{N,p}\ge \lceil Np\rceil]\ge p\) for every \(N\) and \(0<p\le 1/3\).
